newsitem.title: EU: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 273 OF OCTOBER 25, 1996.
newsitem.headline: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 273 OF OCTOBER 25, 1996.

text.p: Joint action of 15 October 1996 adopted by the Council on the basis of Article K.3 of the Treaty on European Union concerning the creation and maintenance of a Directory of specialized counter-terrorist competences, skills and expertise to facilitate counter-terrorist cooperation between the Member States of the European Union (96/610/JHA) END OF DOCUMENT.
